To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Twitter use by students in the context of an educational activity is positively related to their academic grades, (2) Twitter use is positively related to academic engagement and sense of community, and (3) Twitter use is related to perceived self-efficacy.

Twitter can be a powerful tool to enhance students’ academic engagement, their sense of belonging in the academic community, and their academic performance, if it is introduced as part of a well-designed educational activity.
Twitter use is associated with higher academic performance, greater engagement in learning and a stronger sense of belonging.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of Twitter on the students’ academic performance and their perceived self-efficacy.
the effects of Twitter on students' learning outcomes.
the effects of Twitter’s integration in the educational process on the students’ learning outcomes and academic engagement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the introduction of social media in the educational process can be a powerful tool for enhancing students’ academic performance, as well as their academic engagement and their perceived internet self-efficiency.
the use of Twitter in an academic setting, can have positive effects on the students’ performance, their sense of belonging, and their internet self-efficacity.
Twitter, as a microblogging social media tool, can be used to enhance the learning experience of students, and to improve their academic performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Twitter is an excellent platform to support students’ academic engagement, their sense of belonging, and their performance in an academic course.
the use of Twitter as a learning tool in the classroom, can have a positive impact on students’ learning outcome and academic engagement.
Twitter is a very effective tool for learning and for enhancing students’ academic engagement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Twitter could be used to enhance the students’ academic achievement and engagement.
the use of social media, in the educational setting, could be beneficial for the students’ academic performance and their engagement in the academic process.
the integration of Twitter in the learning process, could be a valuable tool for enhancing students’ academic performance.
